context:
Goal: your Nov 4 ruling (item 219 a) lands on main, so any repo's coordinator can ask a Mac session for the two acts the cloud refuses.
Why you: auto mode refuses every session's edit of a CLAUDE.md file, and you chose at 12:38 CST to keep that default (item 335 b). So only you can make this edit.
Departs from: main's bullet (claude-settings coordinator only; three acts, closing PRs included) — any repo's coordinator; two acts (branch protection; delete a branch whose last commit is on the default branch or an archive branch).
Steps: open the link. Replace lines 16-19 (the bullet that starts "Acts the cloud refuses") with the text below. Press Commit changes, pick "Create a new branch", then Propose changes. Runner 8 merges it. Then press Done here.

- **Acts the cloud refuses** (owner, 2026-10-30 16:20 CDT; changed by Cockpit item 219 a,
  2026-11-04 17:44 CST, and its follow-up pick a, 17:55 CST; until withdrawn). When any repo's
  coordinator asks, a session on Shivam's computer may do two acts. It may set branch protection to
  the shared form, with only the all-jobs-passed check required. It may delete a branch whose last
  commit is on the default branch or on an archive branch. A request for any other act needs his word.
holds: Any repo's coordinator asking a Mac session for branch protection or a merged-branch delete.
title: Paste the 219 a grant into .claude/CLAUDE.md
why: Your 12:38 CST answer to item 335: you paste it yourself, through a web-edit PR.
